text:
maria: quick alert - staging quant runtime started OOMing under high-concurrency embed batch tests at ~02:03 UTC. observed alloc spikes then 502s. opening hotpatch window for a small fix (bounds check + allocator guard). need expedited approval to push across prod canaries within 25m.
aj: can you summarize rollback criteria and exact image digest we should pin? also need who is on exec path for rollback.
maria: digest ready `redwood/quant-embed:v2026.3@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe`. rollback image `redwood/quant-embed:v2026.2@sha256:feedface0000`. Fault detection: if 5xx rate >0.4% for 3m or memory OOM count increments >2 in 5m, revert.
ci-bot: CI status - build: \u2705, unit: \u2705, integration: \u26a0 flaky (1 failure), e2e: running. Canary smoke queued.
deploy-bot: created canary rollout stub and holding at 3% traffic per policy: `--canary 3 --pause 10m`. image set to pinned digest. healthchecks passing on first 8 pods.
kim-oncall: support informed. I want a short smoke checklist before I approve full rollout. also notify enterprise customers with private clusters if we plan forced upgrade (they will opt-out).
nate: smoke checklist draft:
- run `smoke/quant_batch_heavy` against canary (10k calls)
- confirm mem_alloc < 2.5GB p95 and no new OOMs
- validate 5xx < 0.2% and p95 latency < 350ms
- run quick A/B compare vs v2026.2 on small traffic slice
If all pass, release_manager approval to continue to 25% then full.
release_manager: I need the release note and confirmed owner for rollback. also prefer forcing auto-fallback rule for 20m.
maria: release note (short):
```
Fix: bounds check in quant allocator to prevent transient OOMs during high-concurrency embedding batching.
Impact: small subset of quantized embedding workloads under heavy batching.
Risk: low (small guard code) - rollback to v2026.2 is available.
```
aj: rollback owner: @aj. rollback command: `kubectl set image deployment/quant-embed quant=redwood/quant-embed:v2026.2@sha256:feedface0000 --record` then `kubectl rollout status deployment/quant-embed`.
deploy-bot: canary smoke results: mem_alloc p95 1.8GB, 5xx 0.05% over 7m, no OOMs. e2e showed one flaky integration - investigating.
kim-oncall: that's within thresholds. I approve ramp to 25% canary for 10m. support will keep pager ready.
release_manager: granting expedited approval to ramp to 25% and then full if 25% holds for 10m. auto-fallback and alerting will be set. adding entry to changelog.
maria: thanks. @deploy-bot please set auto-fallback (20m) and record rollout metadata (digest, owner, smoke_report).
deploy-bot: done - auto-fallback=20m, rollout log appended with image sha, smoke metrics attached. Alerts wired to #incidents and @kim-oncall.
aj: standing by for rollback execution if threshold hit.
maria: closing thread - hotpatch canary in prod at 3% and approved to 25%. will monitor for 40m window then mark as green. :white_check_mark:
